title: Dimension-zero diagonal/deformation orientation and tensor-map normalization
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $n\geq1$, $A=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated etale morphism of finite type between Noetherian schemes (schemes admitting finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]) on which $\ell$ is invertible. Assume $f$ is compactifiable [def-asd-compactifiable]. Work in the ordinary etale derived categories of constant $A$-module sheaves. Write $f_A^\times$ for the right adjoint of $Rf_{!,A}$ and $\omega_f=f_A^\times A_Y$. Identify this adjunction with the etale sum-extension adjunction $Df_{\Sigma!}\dashv f^*$, including its sum counit, by [lem-asd-etale-compact-support-normalization]. Put $W=X\times_YX$ with projections $p_1,p_2$, diagonal $\Delta$ and rank-zero normal bundle $\pi:N_\Delta=X\to X$ with zero section $z=1_X$. Form $\alpha_f:\omega_f\to A_X$ as the composite of (i) $\Delta^*$ of the exceptional base-change isomorphism $p_2^*\omega_f\to\omega_{p_1}$ [prop-asd-smooth-base-change], (ii) the normalized deformation comparison $\delta_{p_1,\Delta}$ [lem-pur-noetherian-etale-section-specialization], and (iii) $z^*$ of the inverse vector-bundle purity isomorphism [thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity], with the rank-zero integration of [def-amb-vector-integration]. Under the above adjunction-preserving identifications, each factor, and hence $\alpha_f$, is the identity of $A_X$. For every $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, let $\phi_{f,K}:f^*K\otimes_A^L\omega_f\to f_A^\times K$ be the canonical projection-and-counit tensor map of [thm-asd-smooth-tensor]. Then
$$\phi_{f,K}\circ(1\otimes\alpha_f^{-1}):f^*K\longrightarrow f_A^\times K$$
is the canonical comparison of right adjoints preserving the sum counit. In particular its adjoint $Rf_{!,A}f^*K\to K$ is exactly the sum/evaluation counit.
